lesson: A LOCAL blocker must be isolated to affected dependencies; disabling all five agents amplifies a small failure into a system outage.
Actions success is not sufficient evidence. Verify the expected file/content and resulting commit. New untracked files require git status/index-aware change detection.

Commit success and even Pages Actions success are insufficient. User-visible completion requires the public URL to expose the expected source commit and generated timestamp; non-material main commits are distinguished by a stable material fingerprint.
